mentions.name: Chartlibrary.io
mentions.description: An intelligence layer for AI agents built on stock chart pattern search. Given the chart you are looking at, it returns 500 similar stock charts, provides distribution statistics over those results to an agent, and can dissect them into buckets by variables, as a new way to interact with stocks in the agentic world.
